notes.title: Blood Rush : Elemental parry update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey ! I hope everyone is doing good, today I'm releasing a new update for Blood Rush.[/p][p][/p][p]This update has been suggested by the community and adds new miracles that affect your parry ability. I aim to publish a small update every month or so with some content while I'm also working on the bigger updates. [i](the small updates do not reflect all the work done on the game)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The ✨ emoji indicates that the feature was requested by the community.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]✨Elemental parries :[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44570519/0a5f2da9bdba87f3095d6b3a9f72f3867e55e580.png"][/img][/p][h3] - Blood[/h3][list][*][p] Killing an enemy with a parried projectile (from an enemy) will grant you some health.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3] - Electricity[/h3][list][*][p]Parrying an adverse projectile summons a lighting bolt on the original instigator.[/p][list][*][p][i]The lighting bolt also damages the surroundings.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3] - Fire[/h3][list][*][p]Parrying an adverse projectile throws shrapnels where you aim.[/p][list][*][p][i]This scales with the other shrapnels miracles.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3] - Radioactivity[/h3][list][*][p]Parrying an projectile disintegrates it, damages and applies radiation build up around you.[/p][list][*][p][i]This also works with your own projectiles.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]- Force[/h3][list][*][p]Parrying an adverse projectile grants your weapons a temporary damage bonus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Important updates :[/h2][list][*][p]Added a letterbox effect when you finish a room to make it clearer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upgraded the movement prediction for all NPCs, allowing you to predict more accurately where their target is heading.[/p][list][*][p][i]Note : This doesn't mean that they are perfect now, this isn't the goal, this won't affect their accuracy when they aren't supposed to predict you movements. This will mostly prevent NPCs from shooting into the ground. (they did that because their prediction code didn't account for collisions.) (Also, I needed this for the next big update)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]✨[i] [/i]Added a visual feedback when receiving a flow buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual feedback to the alchemy weapon switch upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]✨Added a confirmation pop up when leaving midgame.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Changes :[/h3][list][*][p]✨Americium armor now grant a 5% boost to your radiation infusion affinity.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated all flow goals prices.[/p][/*][*][p]Added various sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]✨Improved reliability when a projectile is redirected between lighting rods.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the corridor randomization.[/p][/*][*][p]Better door frames for Haeresis.[/p][/*][*][p]New corridors for Haeresis.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes :[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed weapon phasing through some terrains in Stygos and some assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mega church collision issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the game's memory management.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual animation bug where the legs were sometimes flipped when airborn.[/p][/*][*][p]Refactored the corridor spawning system allowing for better customization for later areas and/or rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when the flow goals were not placed properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where having the left handed mode sometimes shifted your view model over time.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.notes: [p]Hey! [/p][p]I hope your journey throught Hell is going great :)[/p][p]Blood Rush is now part of the Steam Bundle containing my other games.[/p][p][/p][p]This is probably the last patch only focusing on bug fixes, I'll resume my work on game's content. (I'll still be fixing what needs to be fixed in the meantime.)[/p][p][/p][p]Changes with the ✨ emoji have been suggested by the community.[/p][p][/p][h2]Changes :[/h2][list][*][p]Nerfed a synergy that oneshotted any mob.[/p][/*][*][p]✨ Most achievements should be obtained with a better timing.[/p][/*][*][p]✨ Added a Gamma setting in the display options.[/p][/*][*][p]✨ Added some dialogue lines when encountering Argos (early).[/p][/*][*][p]Shops will appear less if you do not have enough to buy anything.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Patches :[/h2][list][*][p]The electrified redirected projectiles shouldn't get stuck anymore on heads. notes.title: Blood Rush Early Access - First patch
notes.notes:
[p]Hey !
Thanks for playing the first version of Blood Rush, some issues have been escalated so here is the first patch, I'll probably do a second one soon since I did not have the time to adress every single report here and it is getting really late.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm so glad you are all enjoying the game, here is the changelog.[/p][p][/p][p]
The  ✨ emoji indicates that the feature was requested by the community.[/p][p][b]Changes :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated relic prices in the shop.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]✨ The blood blade upgrade now displays penetration bonuses.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mobs will now get a bit of knockback when killed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new corridors visuals for Stygos.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated the parry ability icon.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a new room for Stygos.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Epimetheus now stops his animation if you cut his dialogue short.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]✨ Weapon specific upgrade won't be suggested unless you have the specific weapon on you.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixes :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some effects loading while a mob was killed are no longer applied and persistant.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Abel's divine strike should no longer damage Cain.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Skullstriker could shoot negative ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer stand on the door frames in Vires.[/p][/*][*][p]The antichrist won't dance anymore when killing a spouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the shop in Pleonexia killing every single NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized memory management.[/p][/*][*][p]Pandoras box can appear now.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]New version is 0.0.2.0.1b[/i][/p]

notes.title: Blood Rush post steam fest demo patch notes
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you for playing the demo and giving feedback about the game! The full game is coming out the first half of this year in yearly access, and I'm so excited to deliver!

Most of the feedback were positives and really encouraging, some were less but I've addressed some issues with the patches during the steam fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44570519/d3eb4ec11dbeffa983825b288424e99303d18bbe.png[/img]

[b]Changes :[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the weapon codebase to support input buffering. (better gunfeel)
[*] Revamped some old animations.
[*] Updated some musics. (better mastering)
[*] Added Russian and Italian translations.
[*] Small optimisations.
[/list]

I'd like to thank Berry and Giorgia Salvato for translating the game in Russian and Italian, if you want to help translate the game in Spanish, German or any other language, let me know [url=https://crowdin.com/project/blood-rush/invite?h=5b04ebb35712eaf4607ec8c4b82c93562368979]here[/url]!

[b]Patches :[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would freeze the game when shooting enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue that would allow weapon duplication.
[*] Fixed an issue that would allow to equip 3 weapons before upgrading your weapon capacity.
[*] Fixed multiple crashes linked to interactions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon inspect animation kept playing when no weapon were held.
[*] Fixed an crash when quitting less than 0.5sec into the first corridor.
[*] Fixed some collisions issues.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44570519/6e264ae3820d80fe0a4da40c17f0d5a033a5425c.png[/img]
Thanks [url=https://www.instagram.com/alcoun_draw/]Alcoun[/url] for the Pythia fanart!

Be sure to add the game to your wishlist !
